purpose: A source-only checkpoint while the primary build continues; no cache companion launch

decision.basis: The generator removes its restored test clone before writing the final archive. The prior 2GB floor was conservative launch policy, not a generator or user requirement. Unchanged main source, modest new workflow code/logs and a 500MB operation allowance plus approximately 1GiB build reserve support this one source-only capture.
decision.not_authorized_by_this_record: No cache companion capture, source/build changes, cleanup or recurring lower floor for arbitrary larger checkpoints. Assess actual selected payload and copy stages separately.

uncertainty: Planning allowance, not a bound on arbitrary future work-state growth or unknown concurrent storage consumption.
